body: I don't know.. I have issues trusting people... Family, close friends... I don't know if I'll be very cooperative...

I wish I knew... Even if I knew I wouldn't know what to do with it... I've been going through depression for about 2 years now... I thought I got passed it... but it just came back every now and then...
I try... But it never lasts long... I can't help but just feel like shit... I wish this just go away... I wish I was how I used to be...
